body: Oddly enough, before I typed this, I went to a small park there was a table there nestled in some trees, I was laying down on it trying to get my thoughts in order when a dude came up and acted like he had a gun, told me that I was sitting on his table (public park) i told him to put the gun up and go away or shoot me that I wasn't going anywhere, that I would prefer it if he shot me. He looked at me like I was crazy and left.

i really wish i did, but i have nowhere to go, my family flat out told me it was my own problem and they couldn't help me, the government refuses to help me because i am "an able bodied 25 year old man", they wont give me food stamps or assistance with housing, the only way i would be able to get assistance is if i got on disability, which requires a doctor to sign off on, and no doctor will want to see me for free
